# Locales

Set them in the `locales` list of the [configuration](configuration.md), for example `["en-CA", "fr-CA"]`. The scanners pick the locale per paragraph from its language, and per file for resource paths such as `fr-CA/nav.json` or `Strings.fr.resx`. A regional tag without its own file (for example `en-NZ`) uses its language's patterns only.

Spelling classes for English: `our` (colour/color), `re` (centre/center), `ise` (organise/organize), `ll` (travelled/traveled), `misc` (grey/gray, defence/defense, catalogue/catalog, …). `gb` or `us` says which side the locale prefers.
